scope: Read-only local evidence and primary-paper abstract verification; no server login, training or evaluation

base.rationale: Original CBR + LIF topology and protected fusion/init/entry fixes match the archived successful combination. Launch, preflight and package runtime records name this commit; ten relevant archived-source blobs equal this Git commit byte-for-byte. The archived results.csv reaches epoch 200. No other experiment branch is merged.
limits: A launch initialization record alone does not prove final training or test source. Package metadata and matching archived source provide additional evidence; this is still an audit of records, not an independent inspection of server state.
Historical launch/training_state.json remains training, whereas later results.csv reaches epoch 200; the stale launch status must not be reported as the final lifecycle result.
Historical test records were read only for provenance; this task has not run final test.

classes.name: DySample
classes.observed: Single-input continuous offsets and bilinear grid_sample, with groups and optional scope.
classes.LSRT_difference: Low-level Q matches high-level K over fixed coarse 3x3 positions; no offset prediction or grid_sample.

classes.name: CARAFE
classes.observed: Input-conditioned reassembly weights, nearest upsampling and unfolded high-resolution content aggregation.
classes.LSRT_difference: Low-level guidance and center-relative projected-value differences; unfold only coarse 32-channel K/V.

classes.name: SFC_G2
classes.observed: Both projected branches use learned offsets and grid_sample, then attention-weighted addition.
classes.LSRT_difference: L remains at its original coordinates; only the high-level injection is corrected before original ordered concat.

reference_zip.reuse: Mechanism comparison only; no extra_modules package import or source copying

fixed_initialization_source.note: The historical combo checkpoint hash is evidence only. LSRT initializes from the fixed ImageNet backbone source, never from trained best/last. The original three-3x3 stem is not a direct copy of a torchvision 7x7 stem.

historical_data_limit: The original inventory includes file-path and label-content fingerprints but not a whole-dataset image-content hash. Do not claim historical full image-byte identity from this inventory. New plan/preflight/start must freeze actual image bytes and compare them across those stages.

papers.title: FaPN: Feature-aligned Pyramid Network for Dense Image Prediction
papers.supports: Motivation concerning misalignment between upsampled and local features, especially at boundaries.

papers.title: Frequency-aware Feature Fusion for Dense Image Prediction
papers.supports: Motivation concerning intra-category inconsistency and displaced or blurred boundaries during feature fusion.

claims_limit: References support the problem motivation, not proof of this dataset's bottleneck, guaranteed AP gains, first-ever alignment/attention/residual innovation, optimal transport or mass conservation.
